description: "King of Dirt" champion and BMX personality, Tim "Fuzzy" Hall is the brains behind this jumping machine. Nearly every aspect of this bike is new and improved: "TwinJet" rear stay technology with ICT internal chain tensioner, Araya, Profile and scads of Cro-Moly make this the hottest jumping bike of the season. Available in J.D. Green. Nothing jumps like a deere. JX 7.2PRO
